title: Tenecteplase Reperfusion Therapy in Acute Ischemic Cerebrovascular Events-Ⅱ
brief_summary: A Phase Ⅲ, Multicenter, Prospective, Randomized, Open Label, Blinded-endpoint (PROBE) Controlled Trial of Recombinant Human TNK Tissue-type Plasminogen Activator (rhTNK-tPA) for Injection Versus Alteplase for Acute Ischemic Stroke Within 4.5 Hours
